name: Category:Ground Troops
summary: Ground Troops are Troops which can be attacked by ground Defensive Buildings . They must either travel through or around Walls (Except for the Hog Rider , Miner and Headhunter , and those with ranged attacks can fire over them), and they will avoid Obstacles and Decorations when possible (although they can be spawned on top of them and will walk over them when that is the only path available). They may also be healed by Healers .
